pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with relatively smooth edge gradients and rounded vertices. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger, more consolidated patches on the dorsal-lateral surface and significantly smaller, more fragmented patches appearing towards the ventral flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with variable pixel thickness. Junction nodes are well-defined, and the pathways maintain high topological continuity across the visible portion of the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the neck and upper shoulder, indicating a short, continuous mane structure.
